approval_required_for: Any additional pipeline_planning execution after attempt_count 2 equals bounded_attempts_per_stage 2.
Any architecture, pipeline topology, memory layout/runtime dataflow, numeric policy, or template-scope change introduced by the repair.
Any backtrack before pipeline_planning/source_sacg_state changes if bounded repair cannot resolve all current-stage risks.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop before any downstream stage; do not use pipeline_planning_report.json or cached team outputs as validated inputs.
executable_actions.rationale: The latest command failed, and the stale pipeline_planning_report.json was not promoted. Supplied sacg_memory has no active barrier, so a current-stage trust barrier must be recorded before any downstream stage can consume artifacts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep pipeline_planning blocked; request architecture review rather than rerunning from stale reports or inferred risks.
executable_actions.rationale: The supplied summary only states that 4 current-stage risks remain unresolved. Bounded repair requires exact risk text, implicated SACG constraints, and artifact provenance extracted from failed current-stage artifacts without treating them as promoted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote the candidate; retain the contamination barrier and emit an explicit stage_backtrack_request or stop decision with the localized unresolved risks.
executable_actions.rationale: Normal retry budget is exhausted, and current-stage risks block promotion. Run a bounded repair of the pipeline plan using only localized risks and SACG constraints, preserving cross-layer consistency and avoiding any golden-output or tolerance modification.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not enter parameter_binding; keep failed and candidate artifacts quarantined and either request an explicit backtrack to the appropriate source owner or stop for approval.
executable_actions.rationale: A repaired same-stage candidate may supersede the failed artifacts only after current-stage checks pass. Downstream parameter_binding remains blocked until the repaired report and SACG state are promoted and the trust barrier is cleared.

observations: The current pipeline_planning command failed with returncode 1 and stage_passed=false.
The failure reason supplied is current-stage blocking: pipeline_architect_agent status is conditional_approval and it reported 4 unresolved current-stage risks.
The stage framework explicitly did not promote the existing pipeline_planning_report.json; the stale output was ignored and marked incomplete.
Supplied sacg_memory has no active_contamination_barriers, open_backtrack_requests, or open_retry_requests, so there is no pre-existing SACG request to honor before handling this failure.

Because attempt_count=2 equals flow_policy.bounded_attempts_per_stage=2, a normal autonomous same-stage retry is exhausted; any further pipeline_planning execution must be treated as bounded repair or approved recovery, not routine retry.

No retry_reconciliation_contract for this current stage was supplied. A repair flow must therefore distinguish unpromoted failed artifacts from any new candidate and define supersession only after all current-stage checks pass.

The prompt supplies only the count of unresolved risks, not their detailed content. The repair must extract the exact risk statements and implicated constraints from the named command log and current-stage team artifacts instead of guessing.

The available stages begin at pipeline_planning. Backtracking to an earlier source owner is not justified by the supplied memory and should only be requested if bounded repair cannot resolve the localized current-stage risks.
proposed_actions: Block transition to parameter_binding until a promoted pipeline_planning artifact exists.
Create a SACG memory/trust-barrier update recording that attempt 2 failed and that the stale pipeline_planning report is not valid downstream input.
Localize the 4 unresolved current-stage risks from the named command log and team artifacts, producing a bounded repair context and retry reconciliation contract.
Run an approved bounded pipeline_planning repair against the localized risks, then rerun current-stage gates only; promote the repaired report only if all checks pass.
If bounded repair fails, keep the contamination barrier active and stop or request an explicit backtrack rather than consuming failed artifacts.
risks: Artifact contamination risk: the stale incomplete pipeline_planning_report.json and cached conditional-approval outputs could be accidentally consumed as validated downstream inputs.
Flow-policy risk: rerunning pipeline_planning as a plain retry would exceed the bounded_attempts_per_stage limit.

Current-stage unresolved risks may hide cross-layer inconsistencies across model shape, numeric policy, data order, stream/liveness, memory/runtime, template coverage, implementation assumptions, or later board facts.
Because the detailed 4 risks are not visible in the supplied summary, unbounded repair could introduce architecture or memory-layout changes without evidence-based localization.

Any repair that changes architecture, pipeline topology, memory/runtime layout, numeric policy, or template scope requires approval and must not modify golden outputs, tolerances, or downstream artifacts to force a pass.
output.summary: Do not proceed to parameter_binding. The second pipeline_planning attempt failed with returncode 1 because pipeline_architect_agent remained in conditional_approval and reported 4 current-stage unresolved risks. The existing pipeline_planning_report.json was explicitly not promoted and is stale/incomplete. Normal same-stage retry budget is exhausted, so the safe next path is to quarantine failed artifacts, localize the unresolved risks, and run an approved bounded pipeline-planning repair before rerunning current-stage gates.
